_source: Ministry of Education / Curriculum Development Centre, Zambia. 'Physics Syllabus, Grade 10-12' (2013, published by CDC) — Grade 12, Topics 12.8-12.12. Topic, sub-topic and Specific Outcome statements only; the 'Content' column is omitted for the reasons documented in the Grade 10 file. This matches the Grade's own general-outcomes statement, which names exactly five areas: static electricity, current electricity, electromagnetic induction, basic electronics and atomic physics. Physics topic numbers continue sequentially across all three grades in this syllabus (Grade 10: 10.1-10.2, Grade 11: 11.3-11.7, Grade 12: 12.8-12.12) rather than each grade restarting its own topic count. The syllabus organizes content by Grade only, not by Term, so all of Grade 12 is modeled as a single term here. Pages following the Grade 12 content (from the syllabus's own page 60 onward) are appendix material — practical-work guidance and suggested apparatus lists — not further curriculum content, confirming this is the complete topic set.
